notes.title: Demo Patch 0.2
notes.notes:
New Additions

Added Sleeper's Delight, Gambler's Gimlet, and Purple Rain drinks in

Added a new combo of drinks to be shown from main game room waitress

Added animation for Billiard Toss

Added animation for IV Hit

Changes

Changed Sports Fans from -5 HP and debuffs to -5 HP one random enemy 

Changed battle Victory & Defeat sounds

Changed after fight perk selection animation/sound

Changed Brawler's Blend cost to $80 from $120

Changed Sniper's Sipper cost to $80 from $120

Changed Fighter's Flask cost to $60 from $120

Changed End of Demo screen

Changed animation for Quick Jab

Fixes

Fixed Stat Screen bug showing wrong amount of boss's defeated

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1
notes.notes:
First patch since demo launch (only windows patch)! Just some small fix's and changes. Most notable is the Sports Fans now get a negative effect when they get the bet incorrect.

Fixed collision missing near friends on top floor

Added a negative effect to Sports fans when they get the bet wrong (-HP, -EP, Weakend Debuff)

Added 6 new dialogue options to Sports Fans 

Removed "It's on the house" from waitress, that was clearly a lie

Fixed High Or Low leaving the first card on screen when walking away at times

Added 1 new dialogue option to Old Man

Added locked image screen for unlockable characters in Character Select Screen

Increased trashcan search "empty" sound +15%



Thanks everyone for all the support with the demo launch! Had lots of great feedback and interactions in the discord and so far seems like a majority of players are having fun!
